TC-18/S09.title: Custom template cannot be saved without a type (todo: U8 is TFA-92599)
TC-18/S09.detail: Todo — U8 belongs only to TFA-92599 (in progress); recorded: in Hospital and Nursing Home Settings -> New, Save with no type keeps the form open with the required message 'Select a note type', no server error, and no template is saved. Through the API (templates:create) a template without a type is still accepted; Generate with it is refused by the client and the server ('Choose a note type for this template in Settings before generating a note', Q10).
